name: wa_slip_public
how_to_read: Each layer is a point query (does the point fall inside a feature) and, when 'near' > 0, also a buffer query of that many metres (nearest_m = distance to the closest vertex, so it is approximate for long lines/large polygons). near = 'default' uses the --near option of wa_layers.py. near_only = true skips the point query. An empty point result means 'not detected' only where the layer covers that area: see 'note'. SLIP layer numbers change between releases; the dataset ID in the label (DWER-020 etc.) is the stable name.

address.label: Cadastre Address (LGATE-002), large scale
address.note: Parent (street) address only: strata units have no record here. Use plan_extent / cadastre_no_attr to see the SP.

cadastre_no_attr.label: Cadastre (No Attributes) (LGATE-001)
cadastre_no_attr.note: At a strata building the point returns one polygon per strata lot plus common property: the row count approximates the number of lots.

plan_extent.label: Plan Extent (LGATE-284)
plan_extent.note: Several plans can stack on one point (D / DP history plus the current SP): take the SP for a strata title.

zone_lps.label: Local Planning Scheme - Zones and Reserves (DPLH-071)
zone_lps.note: Local scheme zone; read the scheme text for what the zone allows.

rcode.label: Local Planning Scheme - R Codes (DPLH-070)
rcode.note: Residential density code; no hit is normal outside residential zones.

lps_special.label: Local Planning Scheme - Special Area (DPLH-068)
lps_special.note: Special control / use areas and heritage areas defined in the scheme.

structure_plan.label: Structure Plan Boundaries (DPLH-024)
structure_plan.note: A structure plan can override scheme standards.

mrs.label: Region Scheme - Zones and Reserves (DPLH-023)
mrs.note: Metropolitan Region Scheme (Perth). Peel / Greater Bunbury have their own region schemes.

heritage_state.label: Heritage Council WA - State Register (DPLH-006)
heritage_state.note: Statutory protection: a hit changes what can be done to the building.

heritage_lhs.label: Heritage Council WA - Local Heritage Survey (DPLH-008)
heritage_lhs.note: A survey list, NOT statutory protection; nearby entries only show context.

heritage_areas.label: Heritage Areas (DPLH-089)
heritage_areas.note: Heritage areas designated under a local planning scheme.

flood_8.label: FPM Extent of Flooding (DWER-017)
flood_8.note: Covers only rivers/floodplains that have been studied; stormwater / drainage flooding is not here.

flood_21.label: FPM Floodplain Area (DWER-020)
flood_21.note: Management floodplain area: a hit means development control applies.

flood_23.label: FPM 1 in 100 (1%) AEP Floodway and Flood Fringe Area (DWER-014)

flood_54.label: FPM 1 in 100 (1%) AEP Floodplain Development Control Area (DWER-003)
flood_54.note: Extent buffered outward (about 300 m): a hit means the property is in the development control area, not necessarily in the flood.

flood_levels.label: FPM Flood Level Points (m AHD) (DWER-019)
flood_levels.note: fldlvl_10 / fldlvl_100 / fldlvl_dfe / fldlvl_pmf in m AHD (-9999 = no value); fldlvl_dfe is the planning flood level (1% AEP + sea level rise).

bfpa.label: Bushfire Prone Areas (OBRM-026)
bfpa.note: Latest designation; record the designation date. Under 100 m away: surrounding vegetation may still affect BAL.

ass.label: Acid Sulfate Soil Risk Map, Swan Coastal Plain (DWER-055)
ass.note: Swan Coastal Plain only; other regions use layers 4 to 8.

contam.label: Contaminated Sites Database (DWER-059)
contam.note: classification: Contaminated - restricted use / Remediated for restricted use / etc.

noise_spp54.label: State Planning Policy 5.4 Road and Rail Noise (Polygon) (DPLH-057)
noise_spp54.note: Noise-sensitive land-use trigger area, not a measured noise level.

swan_canning_dca.label: Swan and Canning River - Development Control Area (DBCA-028)
swan_canning_dca.note: Development near the river needs Swan River Trust / DBCA referral.

drainage.label: Declared Drainage Areas (WCORP-344)
drainage.note: Drainage / groundwater control area; can carry drainage rates and development conditions.

airport_perth.label: State Planning Policy 5.1 Land Use Planning in the Vicinity of Perth Airport (DPLH-046)
airport_perth.note: Outside SPP 5.1 usually means outside ANEF 20; the ANEF contours themselves are only in the airport master plan PDF.

airport_jandakot.label: State Planning Policy 5.3 Land Use Planning in the Vicinity of Jandakot Airport (DPLH-047)

rail_stops.label: Public Transport Authority Stops (PTA-001), rail only
rail_stops.note: There is no free rail-line geometry layer; distance to a station is the proxy for rail noise.

schools.label: Current Active Schools, public (DET-024)
schools.note: School POINTS only: there is no free local-intake (catchment) polygon, so a catchment claim needs the Department of Education 'Find a school' check.

contours.label: 2 metre contours (DPIRD-072)
contours.note: Flat coastal plain: contours at 2 m spacing may be nearly absent; then write 'flat, contour spacing 2 m' rather than a slope.

roads_main.label: Main Roads (Transport)
roads_main.note: Layer 16 (Roads Simplified) rejects geometry queries; use 18 and 19.

traffic.label: Traffic Digest (Main Roads WA)
traffic.note: Average weekday / weekly counts by counting site and year; check TRAFFIC_YEAR and distance before quoting.
